name: Kraus Erhart
original_name: クラウス・エアハルト
source:
He was born in Jerusalem and raised in Germany. A self proclaimed dancing, singing exorcist. He's a cheerful moodmaker and moody.

He is the only other member of the Spiritus Corps who has a demon, Portugieser, by his side. He is also an exorcist officially recognized by the Vatican, and came to Japan in pursuit of Maria.

[Translated from [url=http://maria.karin-e.jp/dc/02_chara/07.htm]official website[/url]]
